# netbox_l2vpn (Resource)

Manages a NetBox L2VPN (`/api/vpn/l2vpns/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_tag" "example" {
  name = "example-tag"
  slug = "example-tag"
}

resource "netbox_l2vpn" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
  type = "vpws"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  tags = [netbox_tag.example.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `slug` (String) Slug.
- `type` (String) Type. Valid values: `vpws`, `vpls`, `vxlan`, `vxlan-evpn`, `mpls-evpn`, `pbb-evpn`, `evpn-vpws`, `epl`, `evpl`, `ep-lan`, `evp-lan`, `ep-tree`, `evp-tree`, `spb`.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `export_target_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Export Target (`netbox_route_target`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `identifier` (Number) Identifier.
- `import_target_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Import Target (`netbox_route_target`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `active`, `planned`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

